field.incidentDate.label: Incident date
field.incidentDate.meaning: Date on which the incident occurred.
field.incidentNotificationDate.label: Incident notification date (FNOL)
field.incidentNotificationDate.meaning: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.
field.incidentCountry.label: Country of incident
field.incidentCountry.meaning: Country where the incident occurred; recorded as entered without inferring applicable law.
field.claimantName.label: Claimant name
field.claimantName.meaning: Name of the claimant, whether a private person or a company. No separate party-type or legal-identity fields.
field.insurerName.label: Allegedly responsible insurer
field.insurerName.meaning: Name of the insurer claimed to be responsible. This does not establish ultimate liability or a recourse-chain position.
field.claimedAmount.label: Amount claimed
field.claimedAmount.meaning: Amount claimed by the claimant, encoded as exact non-negative decimal text. Zero is a recorded amount, not a substitute for unknown.
field.claimedCurrency.label: Currency of claimed amount
field.claimedCurrency.meaning: Three-letter uppercase identifier for the claimed amount; no currency conversion or registry inference.
field.caseReference.label: Handler's case reference
field.caseReference.meaning: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique, immutable and case-sensitive within one installation.
field.paymentDecisionDate.label: Payment decision date
field.paymentDecisionDate.meaning: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Null until a decision is recorded; not a payment or bank instruction.
field.payableAmount.label: Amount to be paid
field.payableAmount.meaning: Decided amount to be paid, in exact non-negative decimal text. Null until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.
field.payableCurrency.label: Currency of amount to be paid
field.payableCurrency.meaning: Currency of the decided amount. Null until decided; it need not equal the claimed currency.
field.paymentDate.label: Payment date
field.paymentDate.meaning: Date when the decided amount was actually paid, as recorded by the operator. Null while unpaid or unknown. One full payment only; recording does not execute or independently verify a bank transfer.
field.status.label: Case status
field.status.meaning: Administrative state OPENED or CLOSED, independent of decision and payment. No additional case statuses.
